verdict.rationale: Anthropic documents plugin marketplaces as catalogs offering "centralized discovery", and the anthropics/skills GitHub repo can be registered as a marketplace and its skill bundles installed by name, so a catalog of skills exists to look through before installing. However, marketplaces are distributed, git- or path-based catalogs that each user must add, and the evidence shows no browse or search interface, no central public registry, and no leaderboard. Missing for 10: documented in-product browse/search of available skills, a central public registry or leaderboard, independent hands-on corroboration of the discovery experience.
